correctness.rationale: Primitivity, positive radii and Bézout give injectivity modulo 2pi and positive constant speed, so normalized arclength is uniform in t. In the complex monomial basis, independent rotations of sphere coordinates kill all unbalanced targets; through degree three only the constants and |z_j|^2 survive. The first and second moments force nonzero winding, equal radii and distinct absolute frequencies, respectively by testing singleton, diagonal and mixed moments. Every cubic zero frequency now corresponds to a+b=c with repetitions allowed; the corresponding monomial has nonzero amplitude, independently of phase. Thus the repeated-sum-free test is both necessary and sufficient. Reflecting the positive integers below the maximum a_j of each sorted prefix gives at most floor((a_j-1)/2) admissible smaller elements; the midpoint is itself forbidden. Hence a_j>=2j-1, and the speed formula gives the sharp length and unique odd spectrum. At degree four the sphere gives |z_j|^4 mean 2/(d(d+1)), not the constant 1/d^2 attained by a three-design orbit. A separate exact cyclic-character replay checks 1,290 primitive positive frequency spectra in d=3,4; this does not replace the signed all-dimensional proof.
residual_risks: The proof is not an unrestricted shortest-curve theorem. Finite checks concern equal-radii frequency tests; the necessary radii and zero-winding exclusion are analytic.

originality.rationale: The odd-frequency symmetric moment curve and its known cubic exactness are prior art, and neither the elementary reflection bound nor Fourier orthogonality is itself a new result. The supported distinct claim is the complete repeated-sum-free criterion and sharp restricted-class minimum with equality for arbitrary primitive diagonal windings. The strongest compared prior passages give the example and a global conjecture, not this classification or a proved minimum for a class that contains these orbits; access limitations are retained.
residual_risks: The exact passages of Ehler–Gröchenig–Karner beyond the abstract and full matching flat-torus catalogue files were not recovered. The restricted optimum and classification may have an earlier equivalent in unexamined cubature literature.
